# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- Start the app maximized on load, reset the scroll position to the top on startup, and prefer a clean glassy/material color theme.
- Prefer glass-like section cards with subtle borders/highlights for the main workflow panels.
- Use a multi-column repository selector when the available width supports it, so large repository lists use the space efficiently.
- Prefer release assets in this order: release ZIP containing an EXE, then a direct EXE asset, then a source-code ZIP; surface the selected release type in the UI.
